section.53: The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants

53.name_native: The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants

hadiths.text: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:When the servant is placed in his grave and his friends retrace their steps. The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Qatada
